rationale.text: The page has its title in head and embeds a cross-site frame whose document has its own title in head and visible text. Both documents have a title element with text, which is what the test and the methodology look for, so no reading of whether a framed document is a web page changes the answer. The custom check reads the frame (step 3), finds a qualifying title there and answers no_fault, so the finding is passed at full and needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only. This is the first half of the mixed pair for frames.

citations.quote: Chaque page web a-t-elle un titre de page (balise `<title>`) ?
Retrouver dans le document le titre structuré au moyen d’un élément `<title>` ;
Si c’est le cas, **le test est validé**.
